title: Startup of the width-split controller
statement: Let $C,D$ be finite Turing machines over the Boolean alphabet, each with a positive number of work tapes, and choose states $c_e,c_x$ of $C$ and $d_e,d_x$ of $D$. For every Boolean input word $w$, the initial configuration of the combined controller is the seam configuration in its anchor state with every work tape blank.
hypotheses_covered: C and D are finite Boolean-alphabet Turing machines
C has a positive number of work tapes
D has a positive number of work tapes
ce and cx are states of C
de and dx are states of D
w is a Boolean input word
replaced:
On every input $w$, the width-split controller's initial configuration
equals the canonical anchored configuration whose stored words carry the
empty candidate.
